name: A Friend of the Family
summary: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sends a rare likeness of King Terenas to the Cathedral of Light. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker will keep the Menethil Statuette safe.

sections.title: A Rare Remembrance
sections.body: King Terenas Menethil II helped shape the Grand Alliance during the Second War. He lived with deep personal devotion, yet held great standing among humanity's kingdoms. Humble by nature, he disliked monuments made in his honor. Few likenesses were commissioned, and fewer survived Lordaeron's ruin and the Scourge's devastation.

sections.title: Touched by Grace
sections.body: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon sees more than fine carving in the surviving Menethil Statuette. The Holy Light has begun to gather within it, lending the figure a quiet spiritual presence. Bolvar decides Stormwind Keep is no place for so sacred a piece. He sends it across the city to the Cathedral of Light, into the care of Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, who trains paladins.

faq.q: Who was King Terenas Menethil II?
faq.answer: King Terenas Menethil II ruled the Kingdom of Lordaeron, where his people loved him. During the Second War, he united the human kingdoms with the dwarves, gnomes, and high elves to form the Grand Alliance. Together they defeated the Orcish Horde. Terenas was slain when his realm fell.

faq.q: Why are statues of King Terenas so rare?
faq.answer: King Terenas was humble and disliked grand monuments made in his honor. Few likenesses were carved, and almost none survived the Scourge's destruction of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why is the Menethil Statuette glowing with the Light?
faq.answer: Bolvar notices that the Light has gathered in the statuette. He calls Terenas a good and devout man, but gives no reason why this likeness holds holy power.

Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker is a veteran human paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand and a master at the Cathedral of Light. He is stationed in Cathedral Square, where he trains aspiring paladins and oversees holy matters for Stormwind's faithful.

faq.q: Why does Highlord Bolvar send the statuette to the Cathedral?
aliases: why not keep in stormwind keep
faq.answer: Bolvar honors Terenas as the father of the Alliance and believes the statuette belongs in the Cathedral of Light. Since it has gathered holy power, he entrusts it to the holy orders instead of keeping it among the court officials in Stormwind Keep.

faq.q: Where is the Cathedral of Light located?
faq.answer: The Cathedral of Light dominates Cathedral Square in the heart of Stormwind City, between the Dwarven District, Trade District, and Mage Quarter. It is the main sanctuary and center of worship for the Church of the Holy Light in the southern kingdoms.

angles.text: As a paladin, you safeguard a relic of King Terenas that bears the Light's touch. It honors the ruler who first sanctioned the founding of the Knights of the Silver Hand.
As a priest, you can see holy power gathered in a simple carved likeness. It speaks to Lordaeron's faithful legacy, even after the kingdom's lands were destroyed.
As an Alliance member, you remember King Terenas Menethil II as a founding pillar of the Alliance of Lordaeron. Any artifact tied to him is a treasured sign of unity and remembrance.
